entry_points.summary: Propagates approved changes through existing plan artifacts.
Runs read-only multi-dimension audits and emits task artifacts.
Audits existing SPEC/PLAN/TASKS and routes contextually.
Seeds planning with parallel ideation and anti-bias checks.
Runs heavy unknown-root-cause debugging with post-mortem.
Executes tiny plan-free changes with review gates.
Ships diagnosed bug fixes with consult and Codex review.
Orchestrates task queues with fresh subagents and reviewers.
Implements one pending task with model selection and review.
Retrospects one run and proposes harness improvements.
Bootstraps two-tier human and LLM documentation.
Refreshes stale docs and previews proposed updates.
Reviews branch diffs into ranked task-shaped findings.
Plans and ships small focused changes via FIX.md.
Splits large work into one-level cluster plans.
Produces SPEC.md, PLAN.md, and TASKS.md for coherent work.
Maps terrain with citations without recommending an approach.
Final-gate reviews cumulative implementation against the plan.
Diagnoses and patches misleading skill or command files.
Reports read-only run progress, timing, cost, and next step.
Delegates memory authoring to the memory skill.
Drafts semantic TESTS.md cases and links them to tasks.

invariants: Commands are Markdown procedure specs; planning, research, audit, and test commands do not write production code unless explicitly scoped to do so.
Route checks collect deterministic signals first; planning-router is advisory only when deterministic signals conflict.
Every route decision writes route-decision.md, emits plan_route_decision, asks the user, and never auto-executes the target command.
Primary routes are z-do, z-plan-light, z-plan, z-plan-split, z-brainstorm, and z-research; contextual exits include z-audit-plan, z-fix, z-debug, z-amend, and z-maintain-docs.
z-audit-plan is valid only with existing plan artifacts and remains read-only.
Review-family commands preserve evidence separately and promote only actionable findings into task-shaped artifacts consumed by z-implement-all --tasks.
z-implement-all preserves fresh-context implementation by delegating tasks to implementer and reviewer subagents.
Long consult-heavy phases use explicit compaction breakpoints or resumable state files where specified.
gotchas: Do not add z-audit-plan as a front-door planning route when no plan exists; route to z-plan instead.
Route chains prevent ping-pong; after two entries or immediate return-to-prior, ask the user to choose.
z-implement-all --tasks derives BASE from the provided tasks file and bypasses normal slug/tree discovery.
Promoted REVIEW-TASKS.md and MR-REVIEW.md artifacts should be pruned by the user before z-implement-all --tasks consumes them.
z-suggest-memory is a thin delegator; memory mutation lives in skills/z-suggest-memory/SKILL.md.
Plain z-maintain-docs is dry-run by default; docs writes require --apply or explicit confirmation.
